agenda.oferta: Hi, {1}. This is {0}: a slot opened up with {2} on {3} at {4}. Would you like it? Reply YES to book it or NO to let it go. This offer expires at {5}. To stop receiving notices, reply STOP.

consentimiento.texto: To send you notices on WhatsApp, {0} needs your permission. If you agree, you will only get messages about your appointments: reminders 24 hours before, follow-up on your paperwork, and notices of freed slots if you are on the waiting list. Never advertising. You can opt out at any time by writing STOP. Privacy notice: {1}. Do you agree? Reply YES or NO.

consentimiento.rechazado: Understood, we will not send you notices by message. If needed, the staff will call you.
